detail: JSA Advocates & Solicitors advised Nederlandse Financierings-Maatschappij voor Ontwikkelingslanden N.V. (FMO) in connection with its investment in the private placement of secured, senior, unlisted, redeemable and non-convertible debentures issued by Sahyadri Farmers Producer Company Limited. The JSA Finance team was led by Soumitra Majumdar (Partner), with support from Shrijita Bhattacharya (Partner) and Shekhar Shrivastava (Counsel). The transaction involved designing a bespoke security and cashflow structure for an agricultural financing programme, where the principal source of repayment comprised, receivables generated from loans extended by Sahyadri to the farmers under its Farmer…
